# Opeyemi Adegboye Portfolio

> The official portfolio of Opeyemi Adegboye, a Design Engineer working across product design, design systems, prototyping and frontend interfaces.

## Canonical site

- [Portfolio home](https://yemii.vercel.app/): Profile, capabilities, selected work and contact links.

## Public case studies

- [TASAfrica](https://yemii.vercel.app/projects/tasafrica): Mobile-first sports talent discovery and role-aware product design.
- [Limestone](https://yemii.vercel.app/projects/limestone): Community management, offline visitor access, onboarding and safety workflows.
- [StayAfrika](https://yemii.vercel.app/projects/stayafrika): Travel marketplace flows, white-label storefronts, property payments and host messaging.

## Scope

This file summarizes maintained public portfolio content. It does not describe a public API or an MCP server, and it does not grant access to private endpoints or data.
